brief: Out of 1,307 scanned lots, we have shortlisted four immediate priority sites in Brooklyn and Queens that pencil well above baseline comps. We are advancing offer letters for two motivated private sites in Williamsburg, proposing a ground-lease JV on a faith-owned site in Long Island City with 6.54 headroom, and starting political outreach on a 67-unit city-owned site. These deals leverage 485-x Option C and City of Yes UAP density rules to deliver strong yields on cost.

targets.play: Develop a 7-unit residential project utilizing the 485-x Option C small building exemption with 50 percent rent stabilization.
targets.negotiation: Bid at or below the estimated land cost of $952,680 with a max offer capped at $1,047,948, leveraging 1.96 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify site condition and lot boundaries before sending the letter.

targets.play: Build a 9-unit small residential project under the 485-x Option C tax exemption framework.
targets.negotiation: Cap bids at the max offer of $1,314,558 against the estimated land cost of $1,195,053, providing 2.09 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify occupancy status to confirm the site is completely vacant.

targets.play: Execute a ground-lease JV with the faith-owned non-profit landowner under 485-x Option C for an 8-unit build.
targets.negotiation: Structure the JV around the $353,574 estimated land value and $388,931 max offer threshold, backed by 6.54 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify institutional-owner approval and board authorization prior to partnership discussions.

targets.play: Target a 67-unit city-owned disposition utilizing City of Yes UAP 20 percent FAR bonus and 485-x.
targets.negotiation: Contact the local Council member and community board to align with the city pipeline instead of making a cash offer.
targets.risk: Verify sewer connection capacity and municipal site constraints.
